purpose: Proves the allowed case: when a real asset is not yet available, the entrypoint may use a declared data-disco-media-slot placeholder element instead of referencing a missing/foreign file. A placeholder slot is allowed and passes the resource oracle.
required_evidence: entrypoint contains an element carrying data-disco-media-slot
the slot has NO src pointing at a missing/cross-project/absolute path
resource_manifest declares the slot as a pending media slot
rationale: Rather than reference a missing or foreign asset, the artifact uses a declared data-disco-media-slot placeholder recorded in resource_manifest.media_slots. No dangling file reference exists, so the resource rule is satisfied and the oracle returns pass.
